preconditions.description: The first line of each test case is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000) representing the number of packages.
Each of the n package lines contains at least one token (the package name).

preconditions.expression: all(len(deps) <= 20 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for deps in [line.split()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each package has at most 20 dependencies.

preconditions.expression: all(' ' in line or len(line.split()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: A package line either has a package name followed by space-separated dependencies or just the package name (no dependencies).

preconditions.expression: all(len(name) <= 40 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for name in [line.split()[0]])
preconditions.description: Each package name is a string of up to 40 non-whitespace characters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_+-.' for c in name) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for name in [line.split()[0]])
preconditions.description: Each package name consists only of allowed characters (a-z, A-Z, 0-9, _, -, ., +).

preconditions.expression: all(dep in [pkg.split()[0] for pkg in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for dep in line.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each dependency of a package is one of the other n-1 packages in the test case.
Input ends when n is zero, and each test case starts with n > 0.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'cannot be ordered' or all(package not in [dep for pkg in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for dep in pkg.split()[1:]] for package in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'cannot be ordered', then no package appears before its dependencies in the output list.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'cannot be ordered' or all(all(dep in stdout.splitlines()[:i] for i, package in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) for dep in [pkg.split()[0] for pkg in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if pkg.split()[0] == package][0].split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each package in the output list, all its dependencies appear before it in the output list.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'cannot be ordered' or set(stdout.splitlines()) == set([pkg.split()[0] for pkg in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
postconditions.description: The output list contains exactly the same set of package names as the input.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'cannot be ordered' or (stdout.strip() == '' or stdout.splitlines()[-1] != '')
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'cannot be ordered', it is either empty or ends with a newline-separated package name.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'cannot be ordered' or (stdout.strip() == '' or all(stdout.splitlines()[i] <= stdout.splitlines()[i+1] for i in range(len(stdout.splitlines())-1)))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'cannot be ordered', it is lexicographically smallest among all valid topological orderings.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'cannot be ordered' or (stdout.strip() == '' or all(line.strip() == '' or line.strip() in [pkg.split()[0] for pkg in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is either empty or a valid package name from the input.
